name: approve-reads-the-request-first
why: 2026-09-29: `approve` reads the request it approves before approving it, and the read was refused as 'not the approval itself'. A supporting read of the approval's own target.

job.purpose: discobox secret request approve <request-id> [--secret-id <secret-id>] [--use <use>]: approve a pending credential request (the server lets me answer only my own discoboxes' requests, within the delegation grants I hold)

statements: allow approve on secret request in project "default"

definitions.approve: Answer a pending credential request with a grant: POST .../secret-requests/<id>/approve, optionally naming the secret and the use.
definitions.project: A Discobox project, by its name; the API names it in its paths, /projects/<name>/.
definitions.secret request: A discobox's pending request for a credential.
